title: Algorithm Definition
description:
Schema for an algorithm definition YAML file, which specifies meta information and one or more statistical models.

Annotations: any value in this file may carry free-text notes under '_notes_'. Notes are stripped out before the definitions are used and are kept separately for display in the UI. There are two equivalent ways to write them:

1. Beside the value: replace the value with an object holding the value under '_value_' and the notes under '_notes_'. For example 'version: 1.0.0' may be written as 'version: {_notes_: Bumped for the 2026 release, _value_: 1.0.0}'. This form works for every value, and is the only form available for values that are not objects (strings, numbers and lists).

2. Inside the value: where the value is itself an object (a model, 'meta', a reference group, a seq specification, ...), add a '_notes_' key alongside its other keys. For example a model may be written as 'male: {_notes_: Male notes, title: Male, model_export: ./male.csv}'. The '_notes_' key annotates the object it appears in and is never treated as one of that object's own entries.

Schema definitions below whose name ends in '_annotated' accept either the plain value or form 1; object definitions additionally accept form 2 through their optional '_notes_' property.

then.description: Annotated form of the whole algorithm definition.

notes.description: Free-text notes describing the accompanying value. Notes are stripped out of the value itself and kept separately for display in the UI.

algorithm.description: The algorithm definition: meta information plus the models it contains.

then.description: Annotated form: the meta information under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.
Annotated form: the algorithm name under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.
Annotated form: the version under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

models.description: Map of model entries. Keys are arbitrary model identifiers ('_value_' is reserved and may not be used as a model identifier, and '_notes_' annotates the map itself). The special key '_all_' defines shared configuration that is merged into every other model (without overwriting values already set on the model).

_all_.description: Shared configuration applied to all models. Values here are copied to each named model unless that model already defines them.

not.description: At least one model must be defined, in addition to any shared '_all_' block and any notes.

then.description: Annotated form: the map of models under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

model_entry.description: A named model within the algorithm. Defines the display title, path to the model export CSV, and optional predictor configuration.

then.description: Annotated form: the model under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

shared_model_config.description: Configuration fields that can appear in the '_all_' shared block. These are copied into each model that does not already define them.

then.description: Annotated form: the shared configuration under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

model_title.description: Human-readable display name for this model, shown in radio buttons and headings.

then.description: Annotated form: the title under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

model_export.description: Relative path (from this YAML file's directory) to the model export CSV file.

then.description: Annotated form: the model export path under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

model_color.description: Color used when displaying this model. Accepts CSS hex colors (e.g. '#440154FF', '#21908C') or CSS named colors (e.g. 'red'). If omitted, a color is assigned automatically from the viridis palette.

then.description: Annotated form: the color under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

predictor_allowable_values.description: Map of predictor variable names to their allowable input values. If omitted for a predictor, allowable values are derived from the variable-details CSV. Specified values take precedence over the CSV-derived ones. '_value_' is reserved and may not be used as a predictor name, and '_notes_' annotates the map itself.

then.description: Annotated form: the map of allowable values under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

predictor_allowable_values_value.description: The allowable input values for a single predictor variable: either a seq() specification, or an explicit list of values.

anyOf.description: A seq() specification that generates a numeric sequence.
An explicit list of allowable values. Use numbers for continuous variables and numbers or strings for categorical variables.
A single allowable value. A one-element YAML list is unboxed to a scalar before validation, so this also covers lists such as '[1]'.

then.description: Annotated form: the allowable values under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

allowable_value.description: A single allowable input value for a predictor variable.

then.description: Annotated form: the allowable value under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

seq_spec.description: Parameters for R's seq() function. Must include 'from' and 'to'; use either 'by' (step size) or 'length.out' (number of values).

then.description: Annotated form: the seq() parameters under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.
Annotated form: the value under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.
Annotated form: the value under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

seq_by.description: Step size between values. May be negative when 'from' > 'to'. Mutually exclusive with 'length.out'.

then.description: Annotated form: the value under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

seq_length_out.description: Desired number of values in the sequence. Mutually exclusive with 'by'.

then.description: Annotated form: the value under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

reference_group.description: Map of predictor variable names to their reference (baseline) values used when computing model outputs (e.g. odds ratios). These set the initial slider/radio-button values in the UI. '_value_' is reserved and may not be used as a predictor name, and '_notes_' annotates the map itself.

then.description: Annotated form: the map of reference values under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.

reference_group_value.description: The reference (baseline) value for a single predictor variable. Use a number for continuous predictors and a number or string for categorical predictors.

then.description: Annotated form: the reference value under '_value_', with optional notes under '_notes_'.
